description: Returns the whole dataset in one call: format "csv" ($0.25 USDC via x402; every sourced figure, one row each, with source_url, plus dated daily readings and 7-day MRR changes) or "jsonl" ($0.50; one full record per business); optional slug = one business, same price. Included with Builder (csv) and Team (csv + jsonl) keys. Unpaid call = free preview of real rows + terms; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]. Example: {"format":"csv"} -> free preview + terms for $0.25; the paid retry returns the CSV.
name: export_dataset
title: Export the full dataset (paid, x402)
